description: Knox reported 88 'new' Plaud recordings pending transcription during boot plaud-ingest run. David corrected: most of those recordings are already handled/processed. Knox's deduplication against the vault failed to exclude already-ingested recordings, inflating the count and producing a misleading status report in the morning briefing.
what_was_wrong: Briefing stated '88 new recordings discovered, all pending transcription' — incorrect. Most were already processed.
correct_answer: The vast majority of the 88 flagged recordings were already handled. Actual pending count is much smaller or zero.
proposed_fix: Review plaud-ingest deduplication logic (step-01/step-02) to ensure vault cross-reference correctly excludes already-ingested recordings by filename/ID, not just by API enumeration. Knox should report only genuinely new, unprocessed recordings.
recurrence_check: First logged instance of this specific failure mode.
